depiction.primary_object: three rows of squares paired with horizontal bars
depiction.composition: flat schematic layout of three stacked bulleted lines

readings.meaning: outline, agenda, or table of contents

ambiguity: Easily confused with other list, checklist, menu, or layout-toggle icons, and redundant next to to-do items that already sit in a list.

Fix row spacing and alignment in the compact list view
Add serial numbers and purchase dates
Re-order by priority before sprint planning
Archive everything older than six months
Consolidate the three अलग-अलग scratchpad lists floating around on my desk into one place
Send out the bulleted talking points and agenda before Thursday's board call

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a three-item bulleted list. In a to-do app it is somewhat meta and only the best fit when the task is specifically about a list, backlog, agenda, outline, or inventory lacking a more concrete physical subject, and it closely resembles several other list and menu icons.
